title: LLM Generated Persona is a Promise with a Catch

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating U.S. Presidential elections (2016, 2020, 2024) using various LLM-generated personas and measuring the Wasserstein distance between simulated support rates and actual ground-truth voting outcomes to reveal a leftward/Democratic skew.

Evaluating simulated persona responses to multiple-choice survey questions across five distinct domains (climate, consumer choices, education, entertainment, and technology) to observe systemic shifts toward progressive, liberal arts, and eco-friendly preferences.

Conducting sentiment analysis (using TextBlob) and qualitative word cloud analysis on the generated persona profiles themselves to reveal a systematic over-representation of optimistic, positively-valenced attributes and an omission of negative life experiences.

Simulating responses to 500 questions from the OpinionQA dataset (which covers 15 topics including race, gender, misinformation, and automation) and calculating alignment scores against ground-truth U.S. population survey distributions.
